newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: English sneeze gets girl sent home from Irish school.
newsitem.headline: English sneeze gets girl sent home from Irish school.

text.p: Student Michelle Hartnett was sent home from a school course in the Irish language for saying "pardon me" in English when she sneezed.
"I was just having breakfast and I sneezed and said 'pardon me'. My mum has told me to say that for years," she told the Irish independent newspaper.
But the school deemed her to have used entire English sentence during an intensive three-week Irish language course in contravention of its rules -- and sent her home.
